title: Which name ships?
question: Which name ships?
options: (a) Baggage Claims | (b) Sass Case | (c) Sass Case as the product, Baggage Claims as the line | (d) Emotional Baggage
recommended: (a) Every document, the video script and the working title use it. Subject to a trademark and domain check, which is still owed on all four.

title: Is there a crowdfunding launch before the Amazon listing?
question: Is there a crowdfunding launch before the Amazon listing?
options: (a) No: go straight to the Amazon listing and the product's own site | (b) Yes: a Kickstarter is the launch event | (c) Decide after the first gate, when the clips have been seen
recommended: (c) It costs nothing to wait, and the clips' reach is the evidence either way. The tiers and prices are entered as drafts marked "only if it runs".

title: Who voices the bag?
question: Who voices the bag?
options: (a) A generated voice from this app's voice settings, for everything | (b) A contracted voice actor, for everything | (c) Generated for the prototype and the test clips; an actor for what is sold
recommended: (c) The test clips need a voice now; what is sold needs a voice whose rights are clean and whose timing is funny. Whether a generated voice may be sold at all depends on its terms, which nobody has read yet.

title: What is the first market?
question: What is the first market?
options: (a) The United States only | (b) The United States and the EU together
recommended: (a) Every price is in dollars and the listing is Amazon's US marketplace. The EU adds its own conformity mark and privacy duties; it can follow.

title: The lines for the eight sensed moments
question: The lines for the eight sensed moments
options: (a) Take the three marked best for each moment, beside your own | (b) Send your own stars and strikes by id
recommended: (a) docs/design/baggage-claims-lines.md lists every line with an id. Your own lines are kept as you wrote them either way.

title: Which new moments are built first?
question: Which new moments are built first?
options: (a) Overhead bin, stairs and running late: no new part, and easy to tell apart | (b) All fifteen proposed | (c) None for now
recommended: (a) The other twelve stay in the document for later packs. Engineering says what each costs to detect.

title: The scream in free-fall
question: The scream in free-fall
options: (a) Record an original cartoon scream | (b) Clear the rights to the Wilhelm scream and use it
recommended: (a) The Wilhelm scream is a film studio's stock recording; nobody has checked whether a product may use it.

title: What is the New Yorker pack called?
question: What is the New Yorker pack called?
options: (a) New Yorker | (b) New York Minute | (c) Big Apple Attitude
recommended: (b) "New Yorker" describes the character well, and it is also a magazine's registered name; on a listing it could be read as theirs.

title: Which packs are recorded first, after the two in the box?
question: Which packs are recorded first, after the two in the box?
options: (a) A holiday pack and the New York pack | (b) A holiday pack only | (c) Others from the line-up (name them)
recommended: (a) You named both; the holiday pack carries the year-end gifting window.

title: How rude is the Salty pack?
question: How rude is the Salty pack?
options: (a) Rude without swearing, so it can be sold everywhere | (b) Real swearing, sold only on the product's own site
recommended: (a) One recording then serves the Amazon listing, shops and gifts.
